card.name: Ellipses, quotes and web-page placeholders
card.fires_on: Punctuation or filler marks such as an ellipsis in brackets, an opening quote mark, an underscore run, or the words "Opens New Window" in scraped web text. The mark sits where the text is cut, quoted or links out.

modes.label: Bracketed or inline ellipsis
modes.description: An ellipsis marking omitted or placeholder text, often just before a new sentence.

modes.description: A quotation mark that begins a quoted word or phrase inside a sentence.

modes.description: The words Opens New Window after a Reference link in health-page text.
